sourceDrift: docs/modules/board.md says session-only and routes/web.php, but actual routes/api.php exposes Sanctum Bearer GET/PUT board. Actual routes are authoritative.

Muslim docs overstate full first-launch offline capability. Service worker caches fetched assets and public API responses, but streamed recitation, timings and text need network unless separately cached. No audio download UI exists.
Quran raw unified asset is 1,810,855 bytes, not the documented 290KB. Hydration yields every 300 Ayahs.
Quran compact MushafPage omits activeWord props passed by desktop, so full mobile karaoke is incomplete in source.
Source usage counters lack stored hydration and can bank idle time. Native usage cannot copy these bugs as parity.
Roznama upcoming-events label uses today default endpoint and drops past-start ongoing events. Resolve scope intent before porting.
Roznama variable holiday dates cover only 2026 and 2027. Official holiday freshness was not verified in this inventory.
Board prayer pinned city does not override GPS/IP in current parameter resolver, despite its description.
Board notes/tasks pending 400ms edits clear on unmount without flush. Native accepted edits must not disappear.
Quran marker015 license is unresolved in existing attribution. Resolve before bundling or use verified alternative.

Prayer proxy drops upstream timezone metadata. The source nextPrayer implementation treats selected-location HH:MM as device-local time. Default Damascus on a phone abroad has a shifted countdown. A known-governorate timezone adapter and authoritative timezone for arbitrary coordinates remain required.
